posts.name: stylelover
posts.cooked:
Hello,

whenever i play multiplayer i automatically disconnect right at the beginning of the game and need to rejoin. The game speed is also really slow which results in me being way behind my friends progress. Sometimes this leads to desynchronisation and i cant even rejoin the game anymore then. This is pretty much the case since i bought the game in 2016. 

No problems whatsoever in solo mode. 

i reinstalled a few times (on different harddrives including two different SSD), i deleted registry entries and appdata before reinstalling. my pc specs are way above the minimum required specs (also did a pc upgrade late last year).

Only warning in the gamelogs at the beginning is : "WARNING: Could not find achievement controller class for Base_MultiplayerInfection"

I have no problems with any other game and i had two different internet providers in that time span.

 

Anyone any ideas? would be appreciated.
usually its not that annoying , but when we play a weekly for one hour or smth and i get kicket out its pretty annoying.
